# Docs - Relationship Graph Component

[API index](workflows.yaml.api.md) | [Definition schema](workflows.yaml.schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docs.definition.template.component-relationship-graph` |
| Source | `06_workflows/yaml/definitions/docs.definition.template.yaml` |
| Tags | documentation, template, component |

Mermaid relationship subgraph for a single definition page. Renders the
target definition with its parent (`extends`), mixins, and children using
a horizontal layout so wide trees (many children) stay readable.
